name: b2b-events-pr-and-launches
description: Plan B2B events, press releases and product launches: an event planner that works back from your sales target to an event portfolio and a plan per type (roundtable, exhibition, webinar, podcast, event visit, summit sponsorship, AMA, workshop, partner, customer and analyst events); panel question maps, AMA, webinar and podcast run of show, speaker notes and stage demo kits; verified press releases, regional releases, company updates and launch sequences; and event follow-up pilot specs and audits with nurture emails. Every claim is checked and every missing fact is a placeholder.
